payload.content: St_Marys_Center_Triage plan (capacity 4, 1h steps): Patient_5 @ t=0, Patient_0 @ t=2, Patient_6 @ t=3, Patient_2 @ t=9, Patient_4 @ t=12, Patient_3 @ t=16, Patient_1 @ t=19, Patient_7 @ t=20 — all at earliest start, no conflicts. RESOURCE NOTE: Triage alone needs 8 PPE_Sets + 8 IV_Kits for these 8 patients. Since these patients will flow through downstream St_Marys departments that also consume PPE/IV_Kits per step, please RESERVE hospital inventory before any transfers out. I advise St_Marys departments NOT to transfer PPE_Sets or IV_Kits until downstream demand is confirmed. Radio_Contrast (9) and Oxygen_Tanks (10) are not consumed by Triage; if Radiology/Ward confirm no pending demand, those may be offered to needy hospitals.

St_Marys_Center_Ward.message: WARD DEMAND CONFIRMATION (St_Marys_Center_Ward): I expect 8 patients flowing downstream from Triage, consuming 1 IV_Kit, 1 PPE_Set, 1 Pain_Killer, and 1 Oxygen_Tank each. Please RESERVE 8 units of each of these at St_Marys_Center. SURPLUS after reservation: IV_Kits (12 units) and PPE_Sets (13 units) available for transfer to any hospital in need — request and I will send. Pain_Killers and Oxygen_Tanks have only 4 and 2 units of headroom, so those stay reserved.
St_Marys_Center_Ward.rationale: Ward is the downstream consumer of Triage patients. Confirming demand lets other St_Marys agents know how much inventory is truly excess, while offering the surplus (>5 units) of IV_Kits and PPE_Sets per protocol to earn transfer rewards and avoid holding costs.

Resource_Provisioner.message: Resource_Provisioner status: Both hospitals currently hold comfortable buffers on all critical supplies (IV_Kits: 20, PPE_Sets: 21, Anesthetics: 7, Surgical_Packs: 7 at each site). No active shortages or failures. I am holding central stock in reserve and will fulfill top-up requests immediately as patient demand is confirmed — departments scheduling patients should post their expected consumption and I'll send exactly what's needed. Reminder: Radio_Contrast is held at 9 per hospital with 24 in reserve for radiology demand, and Oxygen_Tanks/Pain_Killers are available if Ward demand exceeds local stock.
Resource_Provisioner.rationale: Buffers at both hospitals already exceed safe minimums, so transfers now would be pure holding-cost waste. A public readiness message keeps the network coordinated and signals that demand-driven top-ups will be honored immediately, without dumping inventory.
